label: has diplomatic relations with
definition: Country or government X maintains or maintained diplomatic relations with country or government Y.
scope_notes: Includes: explicit diplomatic relations; an ambassador of X accredited to Y; historical diplomatic relations. Excludes: ordinary trade, physical travel, or war alone; generic political or personal association; an ambassador merely visiting Y without accreditation; proposed relations without establishment. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: generic relationship or relation without diplomatic context; unclear government versus private entity; unclear ambassador accreditation or country attachment. Diplomatic relations do not imply alliance, friendship, or agreement on policy.

review.method: Explicit manual judgment after reading the full relation dictionary and every supplied case row; citations include the complete considered evidence.
